q:
Consider the following statements:
1. Under the Payment of Bonus Act, 1965, an employee who is dismissed from service for fraud, or for riotous or violent behaviour, or for theft, misappropriation or sabotage, is disqualified from receiving bonus.
2. Under the Payment of Bonus Act, 1965, a newly set-up establishment is required to pay bonus from its very first accounting year even if it has not derived any profit.
Which of the statements is/are correct?

Consider the following statements:
1. Certifying surgeons under the Factories Act, 1948 are appointed by the State Government for the examination of young persons and of persons engaged in dangerous processes.
2. Under the Factories Act, 1948, the manager of a factory must send notice of certain dangerous occurrences, such as an explosion or the collapse of a building, even where no worker has been injured.
Which of the statements is/are correct?

Consider the following statements:
1. The Employees' Provident Fund Scheme is administered by the Central Board of Trustees through the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation.
2. The Employees' State Insurance Scheme is administered by the Employees' State Insurance Corporation.
Which of the statements is/are correct?

options.B: The workers, the Chief Inspector and the local authority concerned
options.D: The trade unions functioning in the factory only

q: Under the Payment of Wages Act, 1936, where an employed person enters into a contract or agreement under which he relinquishes any right conferred on him by the Act, such contract or agreement is:

options.A: Null and void in so far as it purports to deprive him of that right
options.B: Valid if it is made in writing and registered
options.C: Valid if the Inspector under the Act approves it
options.D: Binding on him only for the wage period current at the time

options.B: One hundred workmen of the establishment in all cases
options.C: Twenty-five per cent of the workmen of the establishment
options.D: Ten per cent or one hundred of the workmen employed in the establishment, whichever is less, subject to a minimum of seven

q: Under the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947, 'railway service' is expressly included in the definition of:

options.D: An essential service under the Act

q: The unfair labour practices on the part of employers, trade unions and workmen, which are prohibited under the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947, are enumerated in:

options.A: The Fifth Schedule to the Act
options.B: The First Schedule to the Act
options.C: The Second Schedule to the Act
options.D: The Fourth Schedule to the Act

options.A: The contract labour must make their own arrangements

q: Under the Minimum Wages Act, 1948, where an employee works overtime, i.e., for more than nine hours on any day or for more than forty-eight hours in a week, he is entitled, for the overtime work, to wages at:

options.A: One and a quarter times the ordinary rate
options.B: Twice the ordinary rate of wages
options.C: One and a half times the ordinary rate

Consider the following statements:

2. A member of a trade union can be compelled to contribute to the political fund of the union.
Which of the statements is/are correct?
Under the Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970, the employment of contract labour in any process, operation or other work in an establishment can be prohibited by:

options.B: The recognised trade union of the establishment

options.D: The Inspector appointed under the Act

q: Under the Employees' Compensation Act, 1923, the compensation payable to a workman for temporary disablement is paid in the form of:

options.B: Half-monthly payments during the period of disablement
options.D: Full monthly wages for the entire period

q: Under the Payment of Wages Act, 1936, the deduction that can be made from the wages of a worker on account of his absence from duty:

options.A: Can be any amount fixed by the employer
options.B: Is fixed at one day's wages for every day of absence, in all cases
options.C: Cannot be made under any circumstances
options.D: Shall not exceed an amount bearing the same proportion to his wages for the wage period as the period of his absence bears to the total period during which he was required to work

options.D: The average life of a machine before it is condemned

options.A: Nitrogen is diffused into the surface of the component
